info.name: Central Archive - 02 Core & Settings
info.description:
Core master-data and settings endpoints: Organizations, Roles, Users, Confidentiality Levels, Project Types, File Categories, File Types.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080)

## First step
Run **Setup > Login** once. It authenticates and stores the token into `{{token}}` automatically. Bearer auth is configured at collection level.

## Pagination notes
All list endpoints use a 1-based `page` value. Roles & Users use `limit`, `sort`, and `order`; the other endpoints use `size`.

## Auto-captured IDs
After running each **Create** request, the response id is stored into the matching collection variable: `{{orgId}}`, `{{roleId}}`, `{{userId}}`, `{{confLevelId}}`, `{{projectTypeId}}`, `{{fileCategoryId}}`, `{{fileTypeId}}`. That way later requests which reference those ids just work in sequence.
